benchmark_evaluations.question: Which products generated more than 5,000 dollars in sales but had negative profit?
benchmark_evaluations.generated_sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit FROM superstore GROUP BY product_name HAVING SUM(sales) > 5000 AND SUM(profit) < 0 ORDER BY total_profit ASC;
benchmark_evaluations.golden_sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit FROM superstore GROUP BY product_name HAVING SUM(sales) > 5000 AND SUM(profit) < 0 ORDER BY total_profit ASC;

benchmark_evaluations.question: How many unique customers and total orders are there in each customer segment?

benchmark_evaluations.golden_sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_sales FROM superstore GROUP BY segment ORDER BY total_sales DESC;
